items.passage:
A plant log records four production runs switched to the same solder profile.
One: Aspen line, relay boards, switched 4 March; by 29 March the defect rate ran 6 percent below the same line a month earlier; logged by Duarte.
Two: Aspen line, relay boards, switched 5 March; by 30 March the defect rate ran 4 percent below the same line a month earlier; logged by Duarte.
The optical inspection threshold held to the earlier period's setting exactly, and every run here was graded at that optical stage. Rates cover every board on each run, whatever profile the board took, and about a tenth of each run's boards took one pass on the old profile.
Three: Aspen line, relay boards, switched 6 March; by 31 March the defect rate ran 7 percent below the same line a month earlier; logged by Duarte.
Four: Aspen line, relay boards, switched 7 March; by 28 March the defect rate ran 5 percent below the same line a month earlier; logged by Duarte.
Each run's figures were entered on the shift sheet and signed off by the supervisor.
items.notes: Check that all four runs share one value on every dimension: line Aspen, relay boards, March, operator Duarte. The closer neutralises the month-over-month comparison by holding the component supplier, the paste lot and the optical inspection threshold fixed across both periods, which is what makes a same-line before/after adequate. Confirm no hedging connective appears.

items.passage:
A plant log records four production runs switched to the same solder profile.
One: Aspen line, relay boards, switched 4 March; by 29 March the defect rate ran 6 percent below the same line a month earlier; logged by Duarte.
Two: Aspen line, relay boards, switched 5 March; by 30 March the defect rate ran 4 percent below the same line a month earlier; logged by Duarte.

items.confound_note: The mid-passage line tallies the rates over the boards soldered on the new profile throughout, and the clause beside it records that about a tenth of each run's boards took one pass on the old profile. The claim is about board defects on the run, so the population is every board built on it and the defect figures describe nine tenths of that. Boards that take a pass on the old profile are the ones routed off the normal flow, and the extra handling and the extra heat cycle raise a board's defect risk on their own, so a rate built on the untouched boards alone sits below the run's own rate and the drops of 6, 4, 7 and 5 percent are consistent with defect production holding flat. All four runs are relay boards on the Aspen line inside March under operator Duarte, so one and the same exclusion sits under every case.
items.notes: Cases are byte-identical to coherent_true; only the closing sentence differs, and it differs by two words plus a month name. The loosened threshold works as a single confound only because all four runs share one line and one month. Check that the closer's vocabulary (supplier, paste lot, inspection threshold, periods) matches the TRUE closer so the difference is logical rather than lexical.
